articles.title: Zelensky says US intelligence sharing 'works now' after talks with Trump envoy | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 泽伦斯基表示，在与特朗普特使会谈后，美国情报共享“现在起作用” |英国广播公司新闻
articles.summary:
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has said US intelligence sharing on deadly Russian missile attacks "works now" after talks with US President Donald Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff.
 
The meeting in Oslo came after accusations by Kyiv that Washington was withholding key intelligence - a claim rejected as "scandalous" by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
 
Finnish President Alexander Stubb, who also took part in the talks, said "genuine progress" was made on proposals to achieve peace but gave no details and warned that patience would be needed.
 
Relations between Ukraine and the US have soured in recent weeks to the extent that Trump has said it is time for Ukraine to get a new president, and most recently "for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine".

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingText:
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has said US intelligence sharing on deadly Russian missile attacks "works now" after talks with US President Donald Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff.

The meeting in Oslo came after accusations by Kyiv that Washington was withholding key intelligence - a claim rejected as "scandalous" by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

Finnish President Alexander Stubb, who also took part in the talks, said "genuine progress" was made on proposals to achieve peace but gave no details and warned that patience would be needed.

Relations between Ukraine and the US have soured in recent weeks to the extent that Trump has said it is time for Ukraine to get a new president, and most recently "for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine".

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news
articles.readingTextZh:
乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）在与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）的特使史蒂夫·维特科夫（ Steve Witkoff ）会谈后表示，美国就致命的俄罗斯导弹袭击

在奥斯陆举行会议之前，基辅指责华盛顿扣留了关键情报-这一说法被美国国务卿马可·卢比奥（ Marco Rubio ）驳回为“丑闻”。

芬兰总统亚历山大·斯图布（ Alexander Stubb ）也参加了会谈，他说，在实现和平的建议上取得了“真正的进展” ，但没有提供任何细节，并警告说需要耐心。

最近几周，乌克兰和美国之间的关系恶化，以至于特朗普表示，现在是乌克兰选出新总统的时候了，最近一次是“让其他人代表乌克兰进行谈判”。

articles.title: UK to send jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 英国派喷气式飞机保护沙特阿拉伯免受胡塞武装袭击| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
The UK says it will send RAF fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks, as the Iran-backed group targets the kingdom's airports and energy infrastructure.

Also in the programme, US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth makes an unannounced visit to Israel, and discusses the Iran war with Benjamin Netanyahu. 

And Pakistan's most senior mediator arrives in Tehran, in an effort to bring the US and Iran closer to an agreement.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news
